# Constant `pill_editor_core::toolbox::SPACE_ROWS`

```rust
pub const SPACE_ROWS: [SpaceRow; 2] = _;
```

Source: `editor\pill_editor_core\src\toolbox.rs:215`

Both spaces, in the order the viewport menu and the Preferences tab list
them. The panel's own space row switches between the two spaces, and its
label and icon come from [`ToolboxItem::label`](enum.ToolboxItem.md#rustdoc-item-8530) and [`ToolboxItem::icon`](enum.ToolboxItem.md#rustdoc-item-8529),
which repeat the short labels and icons below.
